title: Relocalization preserves K-injectives at independent ring universes
statement: Let C:Type u have Hom universe v, J a topology, R a RingCat.{r}-valued sheaf, U,V objects, and f:V→U. Put m=max(u,v,r). Assume abelian sheafification with its locally-bijective criterion on J/U and J/V. The relocalization functor overMap.{m} R f preserves K-injective cochain complexes. There is no cover or subterminality hypothesis.

source.place: lemma-restrict-K-injective-to-open; the identification of iterated slices is the slice-site universal property.

proof.text: Regard f as X in C/U. Transport sheafification and its local criterion from C/V to (C/U)/X using the iterated-slice equivalence. Restriction to X preserves K-injectives.

The two slice sites and their restricted rings induce an additive equivalence of module categories. Additive equivalences preserve K-injectives. Their composite with restriction is sectionwise the overMap functor. Transport the preservation property through this identity natural isomorphism.
